summary: Revise at 5.5 (round 1: 5.0, Caiman: 7, ship: 7.5). Every recorded gate is green and matches the JSON, and the two gates that failed in round 1 are now resolved. The 6 cabochons sit in registered head.bezel settings: stones.warnings and crowding are both empty, and the closest pair is 1.54 mm. cut_lands now records its 3 Attach::Cut features at 2.85, 3.50 and 3.58 mm against the 0.8 floor. The design moved forward but is still far from the bar. The pinnacles and gable now have crockets, but these are a scalloped cookie-cutter outline extruded flat. In hero-close.png and stones.png they read as wavy-edged plates, not leafy crockets on an arris. The skull is unchanged in substance: two ring-shaped sockets, a triangle nose, a toothless flat jaw and the same sinuous temple lines (stones.png), so in face-300 it still reads as an emoji. The shoulders now carry 3 blind lancets per side, but each is a 0.3 mm shallow sink 1.1-1.4 mm wide. At 300 px they read as shield or letter marks ('J J', 'U'), and on one side of face.png they look inverted. The flanks and palm of the shank stay bare. The head is still stacked flat slabs with 45-degree chamfers: house rule 10's stacked-boxes failure in hero.png, side.png and reverse.png. The 'roll' at the gable foot is a plain cylinder rod. The rear slab still shows only two stray notches. The roof slopes and their roundels are invisible from every camera. The two wall garnets cannot be found in any render. The ring still names a Gothic shrine at 300 px, but density and modelling are well below Caiman's. Round 3 is the last. It must remodel the skull and the crockets as true relief and break up the flat planes, or the ring is cut.
strengths: The subject still reads at 300 px without a caption (hero-300, face-300): a Gothic shrine front with a pointed archivolt, a skull in the niche, a gable and two pinnacles. The silhouette is now serrated rather than smooth, which strengthens the read.
Round-1 punch 1 is partly met: no ball knops remain. Both spires and the gable rakes carry crocket bumps, and each ends in a pointed finial (hero.png).

The stone engineering is now correct. All 6 cabochons are in head.bezel settings that the census recognises (6 head.bezel features in the design, stones.warnings [], crowding []). The plinth row of garnet, sapphire and garnet in pointed niches remains the best passage (side.png, shoulder.png).
cut_lands is populated, with all 3 Attach::Cut lands at least 2.85 mm, and its note says plainly that the niches are covered by the thickness census.

The engineering is clean. Draft and export are watertight with 0 degenerates and 0 crossings (1,282,074 export triangles). All 28 made parts are clean. Nothing is in the bore (nearest vertex 9.300 at r 9.3). The thickness census has 0 wall samples below 0.8 mm and 0 unresolved, on the ring and on the lid. There are 0 DFM findings. Cold reload is identical. Both casting patterns are closed (lid Part(66), 6,238 triangles). There is no Stored mesh.

checklist.item: One theme face to palm, nothing scattered
checklist.reason: The shank's top edge now has 3 small blind lancets per side, at 42, 57 and 72 degrees off the top, but they are shallow (about 0.3 mm), small (1.1-1.4 mm wide) and sit as isolated marks. In hero.png and face.png they read as shield or letter glyphs, not as an arcade. The shank's side walls (side.png) and the palm (palm.png) are a bare polished band. The rear of the head (reverse.png, palm.png) is a blank slab with two unexplained notches.

checklist.item: Reads as its Gothic subject at 300 px without caption
checklist.reason: hero-300 and face-300 read as a Gothic chapel or reliquary front with a skull under a pointed arch, a crocketed gable and pinnacles. It reads more as a chapel facade than as a lidded chasse, but it names the subject.

checklist.item: Figurative motifs have true outlines, crisp
checklist.reason: The edges are crisp, but the figures are glyphs. The skull (stones.png) is still two rings, a triangle and a toothless slab jaw with sinuous temple flanks. Round-1 punch 2 (domed cranium, deep orbits, cheekbones, 6-8 teeth) is not met. In hero-close.png the skull is a flat disc with two holes. The crockets are a scalloped 2D outline extruded flat, so their profile has no lobing or modelling.

checklist.item: Stones in made settings, visible, coloured as stained glass
checklist.reason: There are 6 head.bezel settings and the census is clean. The tints are correct: garnet 0.30/0.02/0.03 and sapphire 0.02/0.06/0.45. The gable sapphire and the plinth row are visible and coloured. Weaknesses: the gable sapphire sits in a plain oval collet inside a hairline circle, not the cusped frame punch 6 asked for, and the two wall garnets cannot be seen in any render.

checklist.item: No flat, blocky or mechanical CAD; forms sculpted
checklist.reason: This is still the main failure. The chest front, the tower blocks, the plinth and the bed are flat slabs with uniform 45-degree chamfers. The 'roll at the gable's foot' is a plain cylinder rod laid on a flat face (face.png, stones.png). The tower set-offs are blocky steps. Large unbroken flat fields remain on the chest front either side of the archivolt (about 3 mm × 5 mm each) and on the gable. Side.png and reverse.png read as stacked boxes (house rule 10).

checklist.item: Factory stock keeps hard wall-to-face angles
checklist.reason: Not applicable: a procedural Flat 4.6 × 2.3 band. It keeps clean walls.

checklist.item: Distinct silhouette; custom head >= 13 mm; shoulder ornament not cut off
checklist.reason: The gabled front between two crocketed pinnacles is distinct among the Tenebrae rings. The head is about 14 mm and stands 6.76 mm over the crest. The shoulder lancets run from 42 degrees to 72 degrees and are not cut off by the head, though they start well clear of it, leaving a bare gap of about 2 mm at the head junction.

checklist.item: Large, medium and small forms; density and legibility at least Caiman's
checklist.reason: Large forms are good. Medium forms are thin: the archivolt, gable, towers and plinth niches. Small forms are limited to the crocket scallops. The chest front, gable field and rear carry no cusping, tracery, diaper, mouldings with profile or texture. Caiman carries three scales of form across the whole top and shoulders. Capsa's density is well below that.

punch_list.zone: Skull (#11-13: 'Loft the skull from its outline into a dome', 'Sink the eye sockets, the nasal cavity and the line of the teeth')
punch_list.change: Round-1 punch 2 is still open. Remodel the skull as relief. Make the cranium a true dome at least 0.8 mm proud of the niche back at its crown. Make the orbits rounded bowls about 1.0 mm across and 0.5 mm deep, with a brow ridge over them, replacing the thin rings. Notch the nasal aperture as an inverted heart, not a triangle. Pinch in the cheekbones and step the maxilla. Cut 6-8 separate teeth (0.25 mm wide, 0.2 mm gaps) in place of the flat jaw slab. Delete the sinuous temple flanks.
punch_list.acceptance: In stones.png the skull shows a lit cranium and dark orbits with shaded falloff, and 6 or more countable teeth. In face-300 a viewer says 'skull', not 'smiley'. In hero-close.png the skull is visibly domed in profile.

punch_list.zone: Crockets on the spires and gable rakes (#17, #21, 'Cut the crockets and the fleur finial round the gable')
punch_list.change: Turn the flat scalloped outline into modelled crockets. Each crocket should be a hooked leaf lobe that curls outward, about 0.5 mm proud of the arris, with a rounded or chamfered face, not a cookie-cutter extrusion with a flat front. Make the spires 4-sided pyramids with crockets on the arrises (3-4 per visible arris), and give the gable finial a three-petal fleur with relief.
punch_list.acceptance: In hero-close.png each crocket shows its own highlight and shadow (a curled lobe) rather than one flat plate with a wavy edge. In hero.png the spire faces show a ridge (arris) line, not a single flat facet.

punch_list.zone: Chest front, gable field, tower blocks, plinth and bed
punch_list.change: Break the flat planes. Replace the cylinder rod at the gable foot with a profiled roll-and-hollow string course that dies into the towers. Add trefoil cusping (3 cusps, 0.3 mm proud) inside the archivolt. Fill the chest-front fields either side of the archivolt with blind tracery: one blind lancet or quatrefoil panel each, 0.3 mm deep. Give each tower 2 weathered set-offs with sloped tops, not square steps. Set a cusped quatrefoil or a rose of 6-8 petals round the gable sapphire in place of the hairline circle. Run a weathered base course on the plinth and bed in place of the 45-degree chamfer.
punch_list.acceptance: Neither face.png nor hero-close.png shows a plain flat field larger than 2 × 2 mm on the front. No straight cylinder rod remains. In stones.png the sapphire is framed by lobes.

punch_list.zone: Shoulders, theta 90 ± (35..85), both sides (#44-49 blind lancets) and the shank's side walls
punch_list.change: Make the shoulder theme legible and continuous. Either replace the 3 isolated lancets with a continuous blind lancet arcade (bays about 1.6 mm wide, 0.8 mm posts, 0.4 mm deep) from the head junction at about 35 degrees out to 80 degrees, with cusped heads, on the top face and down the outer side wall. Or pierce graded quatrefoils (2.0/1.7/1.4 mm) in raised 0.3 mm cusped frames. Orient every arch with its apex toward the head on both sides, and remove the inverted-looking ones on the west shoulder. Start the first bay touching the head so no bare gap remains.
punch_list.acceptance: In hero.png and face.png each shoulder shows 3 or more lancets that read as pointed arches, not letters or shields. In side.png the shank's side wall carries ornament. In hero-300 the shank does not read as a plain band.

punch_list.zone: Back and long walls of the head; roof slopes (reverse.png, palm.png, shoulder.png)
punch_list.change: Round-1 punch 5 is still open. Cut a three-bay blind arcade (0.3 mm deep, 0.8 posts) into the rear face, and turn the two stray notches into the arcade's lights or fill them. Make the wall garnets visible: render a view that shows them, or move them to the visible flanks. Raise the ridge, or tilt the hero camera, so a roof slope with its roundels shows.
punch_list.acceptance: reverse.png shows pointed bays and no unexplained notch. All 6 stones are visible across the render set, and stones.png or a new walls view shows both wall garnets.
